label_provenance: Manually paraphrased from seven public GitHub Security Lab reports. Not independently exploit-validated.
limitations: Positive-only snapshot tasks do not measure PR introduction attribution or false-positive rate.
Public advisory labels are incomplete: unmatched findings require adjudication.
Refs must be resolved to immutable commits by prepare before running.
Development and held-out groups were selected before any agent run; no performance results exist.
